messages:
mira: Quick async sync — continuous-batching sprint status + ownership checks. TL;DR: kernel perf PR landed in draft, KV warmup plan needs an owner, and we need to lock the canary window for next Tues.

mira: Current milestones:
- kernel batching improvements: code in draft PR, perf tests failing at seq_len 2048 on A100.
- KV cache prefetch: design doc ready, needs an owner for infra changes.
- Canary rollout: need to decide routing policy and SLA fallback.

mira: Questions: @sam can you take kernel PR to final? @jordana can you own KV infra changes? Who can set canary window in console?

sam: I can pick up the kernel PR today. I want to pair with li on the failing perf test — looks like a memmove hotspot.
sam: assigning self to PR https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/482 but will mark WIP until we resolve perf. :thumbsup:

li: I can debug the memmove hotspot. I ran `perf record` yesterday and saw heavy memcpy at attention reorder. Will post flamegraph tonight.

jordana: I can take KV infra ownership for the sprint but need a checklist. What infra changes are required?
mira: thanks. Checklist:
- change to startup warmup hook (crontab -> initd)
- add rate-limited prefetch in front of shard picker
- metrics + tracer spans for prefetch ops
- rollback plan if prefetch increases tail latency

jordana: ok will draft a checklist PR and ping @tony for SRE review.

tony: SRE: we'll need a canary SLA and an alert on prefetch error-rate > 0.5% over 5m. Also define a fast rollback path (route -> standby model).

mira: Canary window — propose Tues 09:00-11:00 PT. If that works, i'll schedule on calendar and add to rollout doc.

sam: Works for me. I'll aim to have perf fixes by Mon EOD so we can run perfbench before canary.

li: Flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/reports/1869-kg. Early notes: large contiguous copies from KV decode path, suspect serializer buffer growth. Quick patch to reuse buffer reduces copies in local test.

jordana: Draft checklist PR: https://git.redwood/ops/kv-warmup/pull/12 — set to review. Need tony for rollback steps.

tony: Reviewing PR now. Also can set canary window in Console after you add the canary route. Ping me when route created and i'll wire alerts.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: kernel-batching-draft -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) by sam at 1869001300

mira: Nice — everyone, let's sync final blockers in this thread by EOD. If you need pairing time, drop avail and i'll coordinate. :rocket:

sam: blocking: one micro-alloc in attention kernel, will open small PR. ETA today.

li: pairing avail 2-4pm PT today.

jordana: will finish checklist by tonight and ask tony for SRE bits.

tony: I'll add alert runbook and standby route doc.

mira: great, thanks all. I'll update rollout doc and calendar once canary confirmed.
